lista.entidadeNome: EUSPA-RP-23-26 - “PRIM – Prototype for GNSS Radio-Frequency Interference Monitoring”
lista.titulo: EUSPA-RP-23-26 - “PRIM – Prototype for GNSS Radio-Frequency Interference Monitoring”
lista.objetivo: Increasing levels of GNSS radio-frequency interference (RFI) affecting satellite navigation users and infrastructures have highlighted the need for enhanced monitoring capabilities at European level. The procurement aims at concluding a direct contract for the design, development, demonstration, deployment and maintenance/support of a GNSS RFI monitoring prototype, integrating multiple data providers (open, commercial, and EU-owned) and multiple data sources (terrestrial and space) to detect GNSS RFI events and identify suspected RFI sources.
